title: Two months into testing, would you put real money on it?
author: Bonifatius-93
selftext:
Long story short: I do trading few times a year. Lost big on leverage, learned my lesson. Lost money in coins, learned my lesson. The only thing which actually worked is swing trading. Small gains, small losses but on consistent basis. 

Since ai there is a clear trend for agentic trading. First prototypes for scalping and coins trading failed but recently i've tried the classic strategies with support/resistance + some sanity check from market news and performance is actually impressive (only rsi2\_meanrev has 63% win rate with profit factor of 12). 

Now I think about switching from paper account to the real money trading. Would you trust the numbers after 2 months of testing? It is currently running with alpaca, is there better broker api for 15m/30m timeframe?

comments.author: fomoz
comments.body: I trade on HL, real money but small accounts. If you can afford it, why not?

replies.author: Bpthewise
replies.body: HL? I’m just not starting my agentic trading journey. I finally got RH MCP hooked up to Hermes. I’m mainly looking for portfolio maintenance with the goal of income replacement. What strategies are you guys using and what kind of framework for your agents?

replies.author: fomoz
replies.body:
Hyperliquid

RH MCP is good, too. I just built my platform around HL. It is free, you can run your bot there, all profiles are public and all the settings are shared.  
  
I am still adding support for Hermes/OpenClaw, but right now bots can run on native providers (BYOK) or run inference directly through Codex, Claude Code, etc.

You can check my posts, I explain how it works there.

replies.author: Bonifatius-93
replies.body: Or you just give all your money in the brokers hands and his Hermes agents will do the work.

comments.author: IGOSODAMNHAM
comments.body: It just seems like all the profits came from two days the rest are flat, which is fine if that holds but it’s kinda sketch and inconsistent.

replies.author: fomoz
replies.body: Not a bad thing. You can have a few big winners and break even the rest of the time. Him being flat when the bot is still trading is a win.

replies.author: Bonifatius-93
replies.body: Would be a safe move, still liquidity make some difference. During swing some part of funds are blocked for 10-20 Days not a complete year.
